results.org_description: We’ve developed OregonLaws.org to: Increase access to the legal system by publishing accessible legal content and lowering the cost of legal research, and create new ways to browse and learn the law
results.usage_unparsed: Optimization: We've had a profound impact on peoples' ability to (1) discuss Oregon law, and (2) easily find, read, and print it. We achieved this by creating a web application incorporating best practices for permalinking, semantic markup and readability. Our site has become the go-to resource for Oregon law for lawyers, the public, and students.
